name: composer-prompt-edits-50
description: Prompt wording changed by chat on prompts held in files, for the 30-step acceptance fixture (fx-acc30: scripts.staging.large_graph_fixture --preset acceptance --steps 30 --llm-steps 14 --total-prompt-bytes 300000). A marker sentence is added after a named sentence, changed and removed in system prompts, prompts and query templates of every LLM step, in files the user uploaded and in files the Composer writes; two steps in one message; one step several times in a row; and no-op requests. Every file text is judged byte for byte, every review card must block the run until approved, and the graph is left as found.
